## Summary of Changes

A concise explanation of the changes made, their motivation, and context.

## Type of Change

- [ ] Bug fix (non-breaking change which fixes an issue)
- [ ] New feature (non-breaking change which adds functionality)
- [ ] Breaking change (fix or feature that would cause existing functionality to not work as expected)
- [ ] Documentation update
- [ ] Performance improvement / Refactoring

## Verification & Testing

Describe how the changes were tested:

- [ ] Backend test suite passed (`pytest -q`)
- [ ] Bytecode compilation verified (`compileall app tests`)
- [ ] Frontend strict type-check passed (`npm run typecheck`)
- [ ] Frontend production build verified (`npm run build`)
- [ ] Manual end-to-end verification performed

## Screenshots / Video (if applicable)

Attach screenshots or recordings demonstrating the change.
